old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ejth","title":"Gateway slot claims expose a forgeable signature_valid authorization bit","description":"Security review P1. New rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs represents authentication as public bool SlotClaim.signature_valid and exposes with_valid_signature(), which simply sets it true without a signature, key, TOFU pin, transcript, or verification. resolve_conflict treats that bit as authoritative, so any caller/decoder can forge a lower-IID valid claim and win overlapping slots.
